senses.gloss: (denom. of חַכָּה) to insert a hook, to fish with the angle, to fasten. Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7ᶜ אם לחַכּוֹת בו if it is a sûgar (v. סוּגַר) with which to fasten a dog (by inserting the hook of a chain), opp. בשביל שלא לאכול one intended to prevent from eating (a muzzle); Y. Bets. II, end, 61ᵈ (not להכות).
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81a:1">B. Kam. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>ומְחַכִּין בימה וכ׳</he> and that people be free to fish with the angle in the lake of Tiberias.
Hos. VI, 9); to wait for, hope, be anxious for (with ל).

<cite ref="Habakkuk 2:3">Hab. II, 3</cite>) <he>הַכֵּה לו</he> wait for it (the redemption); <cite ref="Habakkuk 2:3">ib.</cite> <he>אנו מְחַכִּין והוא אינו מְחַכֶּה</he> we are anxious, but He is not (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 30:18">Is. XXX, 18</cite>).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 34:1">Pesik. R. s. 34</cite>; Yalk. Zeph. 567; a. e. [<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 604:2">Yalk. Lev. 604</cite> <he>מחכה</he>, v. <he>הָקָה</he>.]
